what_this_is: the state of the batch partition while this workstream tried to obtain a trustworthy 1-thread CPU certification shard, recorded because it is the reason two attempts were contaminated and the third is queued behind a four-hour wait

attempts.mechanism: bench_step3, reference timed once in a block after the sweep
attempts.outcome: rejected after the fact: the same renderer read 125.4 and 55.5 f/s in the two arms of one job, a 2.3x swing, and a single block-timed reading cannot record it

attempts.mechanism: certify_shard.py, reference interleaved between every batch cell
attempts.outcome: rejected by its own run-spread check (certifiable: false)

attempts.mechanism: + a 12-burst pre-flight on the reference before any renderer work
attempts.outcome: rejected in 13 s on the pre-flight, before the sweep was attempted

attempts.mechanism: the same, aimed at the quietest node in the partition (load/core 0.29, 103 idle)
attempts.outcome: rejected; the quietest node available was indistinguishable from the busiest one tried, which is what makes this a partition finding rather than bad luck

attempts.mechanism: --exclusive, 48 cores, 75 s settle, abort above load average 4
attempts.outcome: never ran: pended two hours with the estimate slipping 02:03 -> 05:34 and finally reported QOSMaxCpuPerUserLimit. The normal QOS caps a user at cpu=64 and an exclusive allocation charges the whole node (48 or 192 cores here), so on a 192-core node the request can never be satisfied and on a 48-core node it queues behind a saturated partition. Cancelled so the three attempts stayed three.

why_exclusivity_is_needed: S_cpu is a ratio to a single-threaded pygame loop. OverSubscribe is NO on this partition, so no other job takes our core -- but jobs do share a NODE, and a co-tenant on the other 40 cores is inside the denominator through memory bandwidth and cache. Both contaminated attempts were on shared nodes.
verdict: the certification partition could not produce a trustworthy 1-thread CPU shard in three attempts, so cores_cpu is not measured for these five configurations and the page carries no cores/BELOW_G4 for them. S_cpu IS measured and certifiable (sweep/cpu_1thread_paired_after_node1829.json, worst reference spread 1.11x).
acceptance_criterion: reference spread <= 1.25x, measured across readings interleaved with the renderer; never relaxed
what_would_fix_it: an exclusive allocation, which needs either a QOS whose cpu cap is at least one node's core count or free 48-core nodes. Neither is in this workstream's gift.
